answer: Receiver-bound reward quotas give each certified instrument one claim per epoch. An agent observing a comet or checking a jetty beacon submits a fresh signal trace signed by its receiver over a verifier nonce. The verifier checks the signature and rejects a second claim from the same hardware identity. N claim slots require buying or renting N receivers. This assumes the manufacturer issues one non-clonable credential per instrument and the signed trace comes from the sensor, not an injected file.
